payload.summary: Published complete longitudinal quality evidence and README under VXU Labs. All four paired projects passed 120/120 primary functional cases, 52/52 exact intent checks and 9,216/9,216 exploratory stress checks in each arm; no quality advantage over instructed Markdown baseline observed. All 72 primary snapshots and all 18,432 stress flags independently replayed. Version 2 stress protocol/results retained; version 3 repaired macOS path/output infrastructure only, preserves original scoring/input/oracle hash and every original flag. Configured quality and stress checks passed stable snapshot 26b13599b59995cbef86f7a79872aca42552109d2e6b67e7380bd55359cb745b. CI 37502649321 on b00fc0c passed Windows, Linux and macOS. No authentication copies remain, public credential/path scan clean, all 22 tracked Markdown files have no em dash. Future improvements B01 and B02 remain backlog.
payload.next: Experiment complete. Preserve datasets unchanged; future naturalistic/default-agent and multi-day studies require separate protocols.
